params.name: input
params.label: Input
params.description: The node whose geometry is the first operand, the shape the second is combined with or cut from.

params.name: with
params.label: With
params.description: The node whose geometry is the second operand: joined for Union, kept in common for Intersect, or cut away for Subtract.

params.name: operation
params.label: Operation
params.description: Union joins both shapes, Intersect keeps only where they overlap, and Subtract removes the With shape from the Input.

params.name: voxel_size
params.label: Voxel Size
params.description: Grid spacing in world units of the distance fields both shapes are sampled on. Smaller gives finer, cleaner edges but costs more.
